title: Types of AI
description: Not all AI is the same! Let's explore the three big types of AI, and find out which one actually exists today.

content.value: Scientists describe AI in three levels based on how smart and flexible it is: Narrow AI, General AI, and Super AI. Think of it like a ladder, we are standing firmly on the first rung, and the top rungs are still out of reach.
1. Narrow AI (the AI we have today)

Narrow AI is really good at ONE specific job. A chess program can beat world champions at chess, but ask it to drive a car or cook dinner and it has no idea what to do. It only knows its one task. Almost every AI you use today is Narrow AI.

A helpful comparison: a Narrow AI is like a superstar chess player who has never done anything except play chess. Amazing at that one thing, helpless at everything else. Even a powerful chatbot like ChatGPT is Narrow AI, its one job is working with language.

Narrow AI examples:
♟️  Chess & game-playing programs
💬  ChatGPT and chatbots
🎯  Recommendation systems (YouTube, Spotify)
📧  Spam email filters
🚗  Self-driving car software
🩺  Tools that read medical scans

General AI would be as flexible as a human, able to learn and do ANY task across many different areas, from writing a poem to fixing a bike to planning a birthday party. A single system could switch between totally different problems, just like you do every day. This kind of AI does not exist yet. It's still a goal that researchers are working toward.

Super AI is a conceptual idea of a machine that is smarter than humans at almost everything, from science to art to making decisions. It only exists in movies and imagination for now. Thinking about it isn't just for fun, it helps researchers plan how to build AI safely, long before anything like it could ever exist.

Narrow AI   → great at ONE task        → exists today ✅
General AI  → flexible like a human     → not built yet ⏳
Super AI    → smarter than all humans   → just an idea 💭

Activity: 'AI or Not?': Look at examples like a smart thermostat, a wind-up toy, a self-driving car, and a regular calculator. Which ones use AI, and which just follow fixed rules? For the AI ones, notice they each do just one narrow job.
Key Takeaway: Most AI systems today are Narrow AI, brilliant at one task, but not flexible like a human. General and Super AI don't exist yet.

quiz.question: Which type of AI do we actually use today?
quiz.explain: Everything from chatbots to recommendation systems is Narrow AI, great at one specific task. General and Super AI don't exist yet.

quiz.question: What makes General AI different from Narrow AI?
options: It could do almost any task, like a human, across many areas
quiz.explain: General AI would be flexible across many different tasks, just like a person, but it hasn't been built yet.

quiz.question: A program that ONLY recommends songs is an example of...
quiz.explain: It does one job, recommending songs, which makes it Narrow AI.

quiz.question: Why do researchers think about Super AI even though it doesn't exist?
options: To help plan how to build AI safely in the future
Because it already runs on every phone
To make video games load faster
quiz.explain: Super AI is just an idea for now, but imagining it helps researchers think ahead about safety and responsible design.
